alarms.action: Latches M290; triggers ST20 fault M299, aborts cycle to VENT (M205), and sets FAIL (M211)
alarms.condition: Test pressure not reached within fill timeout period (T21 expires while in FILL M202)
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Sets latched alarm M291; triggers ST20 fault M299, forces fill valve closed, holds vent valve Y22 open, sets FAIL
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Turns on unlatched alarm M292; triggers M299 (inhibits cycle start) and blocks unclamp transition out of VENT (R22)
alarms.condition: PT-2001 reading below -5.00 kPa (D100 < K-500, indicating wire break)
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Sets latched alarm M293; triggers ST20 fault M299, aborts cycle to VENT, sets FAIL
alarms.condition: Supply air switch PS-2009 lost while station busy (M200 AND ANI X22)
alarms.name: Supply air low

conflicts.parameter_sheet_says: 5.0 s (T22, changed from 3.0 s by MOC-2021-044)
conflicts.program_says: 5.0 s (R13 uses OUT T22 K50, where 100 ms * K50 = 5.0 s)
5.0 s (R21 uses OUT T200 K50 on FX5U 100 ms timer base, instead of 0.5 s / T24)

interlocks.cause: Pallet sensor (X23) drops and returns while test is running (M200 ON)
interlocks.effect: Cycle restart is inhibited (ANI M200 in start rung R8)

interlocks.cause: Clamp confirmed closed lost (loss of X20 / clamp not closed in step M202)
interlocks.effect: Fill valve (XV-2003 / Y21) cannot open / closes immediately (driven only in M202)
Fill valve XV-2003 (Y21) forced closed; active cycle aborts to VENT (M205) with FAIL result (M211)
Fill valve closed; vent valve XV-2004 (Y22) held open; fault beacon Y25 energized

interlocks.cause: Vent incomplete (pressure >= 1.00 kPa or vent timer running) or PT-2001 fault active (M292)
interlocks.effect: Unclamp is inhibited; station holds in VENT step (M205) with vent valve open

interlocks.cause: Manual vent pushbutton PB-2010 (X25) pressed while in manual mode (ANI X2)
E-stop chain not healthy (ES-0001 / X0 OFF)
interlocks.effect: ST20 fault flag M299 turns ON, aborting cycle to VENT with FAIL result

steps.entry: Initial state or pallet cleared at DONE (LDF X23 / ANI X23 resets M207 and M200)
steps.exit: Pallet arrives in test position (LDP X23) with cell in auto (X2), no active ST20 fault (ANI M299), and station idle (ANI M200)
steps.name: START / IDLE

steps.entry: Start conditions met; sets M200 (busy) and M201 (clamp step)
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (X20) and not open (ANI X21)
steps.name: CLAMP (M201)

steps.exit: Pressure reaches fill threshold PT-2001 >= 14.50 kPa (D100 >= D122) or aborts on fill timeout (T21) / active fault (M299)
steps.name: FILL (M202)

steps.entry: Test window complete (T23 done), or fault abort while busy (M299 AND M200)
steps.exit: Vent timer complete (T200 / T24 done), pressure vented below 1.00 kPa (D100 < K100), and PT-2001 signal healthy (ANI M292)
steps.name: VENT (M205)

steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (X21) and clamp closed switch clear (ANI X20)
steps.name: UNCLAMP (M206)
